claim: DG Connect runs the session 'Building AI in Europe: Practical Support for Innovators' on 11 November at 14:30.
HaDEA hosts the session 'Investing in technological sovereignty: EU funding for your project' at 15:30.
EuroHPC runs the session 'Level up for free: Access EU supercomputing, AI & quantum resources' at 16:00.
HaDEA has a stand at E418 in Pavilion 4 throughout the summit.
Técnico shows robots at stand E272 in Pavilion 2 from 10 to 12 November.
Granter has just raised €1.6 million to expand into Spain, Germany and Italy.
Granter won Web Summit's PITCH competition in 2025.
Técnico brings six spin-offs to the summit: Acubic, Keel, Opsivision.ai, RTBEAMTECH, RipeNew and Testwaves.
PERSEPHONE develops autonomous robots for safer mining of critical raw materials.
DG GROW is at stand E415 and EuroHPC is at stand E405.
